Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate,Nisaruddin Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
List revised learned counsel for the applicants is present none appeared for the opposite party even in the revised call.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material on record.

This application has been filed with a prayer to allow this application and quash the entire criminal proceeding and order dated 25.10.2005 in Complaint Case No. 6491 of 2005 (Gulnaz Bano Vs.
Abdul Kalam and others) pending before the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Allahabad under Sections Raziya Bano And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30015525/
1 498A I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act and also further prayed to stay the further proceeding in the aforesaid case.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that in this case the applicants are married Nanad and Nandoi of opposite party no. 2 who was wedded to Abdul Kalam.

sentences.text: As per allegation in the complaint, the opposite party no. 2 was being harassed by her husband, mother-in-law and present applicants in relation to demand of dowry and harassment.

It is also submitted that there is allegation that Rs. 50,000/- were being demanded with Hero Honda motorcycle by her husband,
mother-in-law and present applicants.
It is also submitted that the contents of the complaint disclose no any specific role of the applicants for making harassment to the opposite party no. 2 but it is against her husband.
It is also submitted that applicants were not resident in the village of the opposite party no. 2 but they were living at Varanasi.
There may be no any interest of applicants in making demand of Rs. 50,000/- or any making harassment to the opposite party no. 2.

It is also submitted that incident of maar-peet has been alleged to have taken place on 21.12.2004 when the opposite party no. 2 was coming back from the court to her house she was beaten by her husband and one unknown person and was also abused by him.
There is no any allegation against the present applicants.
The applicants were roped in the complaint by opposite party no. 2 only for making pressure on the husband with false allegations.

He relied his argument on the case of Geeta Mehrotra & Anr Vs. State of U.P. on 17 October, 2012 in Criminal Appeal No. 1674 of 2012 and on the case of Mirza Iqbal @ Golu & Anr. Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr in Criminal Appeal No. 1628 of 2021, therefore, request to quash the entire proceedings of the case including the summoning order.

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid.

On considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the applicants as well as learned A.G.A. and perusal of record, the contents of the complaint and the statements of the complainant and other witnesses, it appears that there is general allegations of demand of dowry of Rs. 50,000/-
at the time of solemnization of marriage and causing harassment against the applicants also but no any specific role has been assigned to them.
The role of maar-peet has been given to her husband even at home and also on the way from court to her home.
The circumstances of the case shows that the applicants had been named in the complaint only for making pressure on the husband of the opposite party no. 2.

These facts were not taken into consideration by the learned court concerned while passing the order dated 25.10.2005 against the applicants with other co-accused persons under Sections 498A I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act.
In this way, if the proceedings are permitted to continue it will amount to misuse of process of the court.
As a result, the order passed by the learned court concerned to the extent of present applicants those are married Nanad and Nandoi are liable to be quashed.

Accordingly, this application is allowed and entire proceedings of Complaint Case No. 6491 of 2005 (Gulnaz Bano Vs. Abdul Kalam and others) pending before the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Allahabad under Sections 498A, I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act to the extent of present applicants are hereby quashed.
